### Renovation

The Staatsgalerie Stuttgart will be extensively modernized and renovated in the coming years.

For this reason, our **masterpieces of Classical Modernismare currently not on view.** Starting February 20, 2027, they will be on display under the title “Simply the Best!” at the Kunstgebäude on Schlossplatz.

Thank you very much for your understanding regarding any restrictions!

[More information](/en/visit/renovation "Renovation")
